_comment: Build sources and reference repos for Optimum. 'compile' entries are built from source. 'reference' entries are cloned for code reading/mapping but NOT compiled - the vanilla DLLs are used instead.
_1.22.6_check: Checked 2026-07-31 via 'git ls-remote https://github.com/anegostudios/<repo>.git HEAD' - vsapi/vsessentialsmod/vssurvivalmod/vscreativemod/Cairo all still HEAD at the exact refs pinned below for 1.22.5. The compiled 1.22.6 client is already out, but the matching source hasn't been pushed yet. Re-check before bumping vintageStoryVersion.
_1.22.6_bridge: VERIFIED 2026-08-05: 'bash scripts/bootstrap.sh --version 1.22.6' (or 'make bootstrap VERSION=1.22.6') followed by 'dotnet build VintageStory.slnx -c Release' succeeds end-to-end against the real 1.22.6 client (95/95 patches applied, 0 build errors). patches-1.22.6-bridge/ reconstructs the confirmed 1.22.6 source-level changes for vsapi/vsessentialsmod/vssurvivalmod only (the three of five compile-from-source repos with real changes) on top of the refs pinned below. VintagestoryLib/Vintagestory need NO bridge - bootstrap.sh decompiles them fresh from whichever --version's client archive it downloads, so they're already 1.22.6-shaped once decompiled; vscreativemod and Cairo need no bridge either (confirmed identical to 1.22.6 by full decompiled sweep). One real Optimum patch (patches/VintagestoryLib/Vintagestory.Server/ServerSystemLoadAndSaveGame.cs.patch) collided with 1.22.6's own restoreLogsFolder feature and was fixed at the source (reduced context) during verification. See patches-1.22.6-bridge/README.md for the full story, including two bootstrap.sh bugs found and fixed along the way.
